items.title: Walt Disney (DIS) Picks Its First CTO In Broad Leadership Reset
items.summary: Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) has created a new Chief Technology Officer role and hired Karandeep Anand to fill the position. Anand is joining Disney with several team members from Character.AI to support the group’s technology and product agenda. Disney has reshaped its leadership in streaming and content, naming Adam Smith Chairman of Direct-to-Consumer and Joe Earley President, Disney Entertainment Television Franchise and Content Strategy.
